potions.name: Pond Scum Pep
potions.flavor: Technically it's algae tea, but the Brewer insists on calling it 'wetland espresso'. Fish find your hook noticeably more interesting; friends find your breath noticeably less.

potions.name: Tiny Fry Tonic
potions.flavor: Six very small fish, one very small cauldron, one surprisingly large lesson about patience. Tastes like childhood summers and faintly of minnow.

potions.name: River Runner's Brew
potions.flavor: Brewed at a rolling simmer because the river never sits still and neither should the pot. Drink it and the current starts whispering where the fish are hiding.

potions.name: Steady Sipping Syrup
potions.flavor: Thick as lake fog and twice as calm. The Brewer stirs it exactly once an hour, on principle, and your reeling hand learns the same restraint.

potions.name: Brackish Broth
potions.flavor: Smells like a swamp because it is, in every meaningful sense, a swamp. Somehow it settles the nerves the way only a warm bog can.

potions.name: Sewer Sheen
potions.flavor: The Potion Brewer swears the shimmer is 'mostly minerals'. Whatever swims through the undercity apparently knows where all the loose coins settle.

potions.name: Salt Spray Cordial
potions.flavor: Bottled at high tide with a pinch of gull feather for luck. One sip and the bite window stretches out like a lazy cat in a sunbeam.

potions.name: Glacier Glaze
potions.flavor: Served cold, obviously; the Brewer once tried it warm and would rather not discuss it. Your hands go still as old ice and the fish stop noticing you're there.

potions.name: Reef Rainbow Reduction
potions.flavor: Five reef fish, simmered until the pot starts humming in color. It never comes out the same shade twice, and neither does whatever bites next.

potions.name: Lanternlight Cordial
potions.flavor: Glows softly in the dark, like a nightlight for your stomach. Cave fish brewed with a rare catch teach your eyes to find what hides at the edges.

potions.name: Big Fish Bisque
potions.flavor: A hearty soup for anglers with hearty ambitions. Eat a big fish, become the kind of person big fish want to meet — the food chain is mostly confidence anyway.

potions.name: Harbormaster's Grog
potions.flavor: The recipe is stamped, notarized, and slightly illegal in three ports. Everything you haul up afterwards seems to have a price tag and occasionally a padlock.

potions.name: Double Hook Decoction
potions.flavor: Brewed from fish that never learned to travel alone. Drink up and neither will your catches — the Brewery does not offer refunds for tangled lines.

potions.name: Abyssal Ink Elixir
potions.flavor: It drinks you back, a little. The trench keeps its secrets in the dark, and for twenty-five minutes the dark decides you're trustworthy.

potions.name: Caldera's Kiss
potions.flavor: Legendary scales dissolved in hot spring water, still gently boiling in the bottle. Whatever takes your hook afterwards will be built to match your new opinion of yourself.

potions.name: Leviathan's Lullaby
potions.flavor: One mythic catch, two colossal ones, and a Brewer who didn't sleep for a week. The sea goes quiet when you uncork it — not empty, listening.
